title: Paul Baron's orchestra on the Mildred Bailey radio show
summary: He was a regular on Mildred Bailey's show with Teddy Wilson and Charlie Shavers, and played in Raymond Scott's band, for about a season.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Chilton, it mentioned you were working with Claude Hopkins.
I did. I worked up at the Hurricane Club there with Claude Hopkins. And who else?

Yeah. Well, I played with Paul Baron, because Paul used to do the Mildred Bailey show, and on that show she used a lot of jazz musicians on that show. Teddy Wilson used to play it. Charlie Shavers played it; Stuff Smith played quite a few of those shows, and sometimes Mary Lou Williams would sit in on some of those shows.

Yeah, we did it regularly. I was a regular on that show, and so was Charlie, and so was Teddy.
I don't know. It was radio. I don't know whether it was CBS or -- it was -- I don't know, but it was the Mildred Bailey Show. I remembered that, yeah. And I also played with Raymond Scott.
Yeah, I think he was CBS. I'm not sure, but Charlie was on that band too, Charlie Shavers and myself. We were on that band together.
With Mildred Bailey? I don't know. I guess I did about one season of those shows, you know. About 12 or 13 weeks, something like that.
